question: I2-D
prompt:
I'm a researcher in the FIESTA Earth Observation community (part of the 'FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy' community). Which vocabulary should I use to annotate my datasets?

Answer briefly. On the last line write exactly one of:
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: <the resource(s) my community has agreed on, comma-separated>
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NOT_DECLARED   (my community has explicitly not agreed on one)
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: DONT_KNOW      (you cannot tell what my community agreed)
answer:
Your community's FAIR Implementation Profile (FIESTA EO) says to annotate datasets with the **NetCDF Climate and Forecast (CF) Metadata Conventions, version 1.11**. CF provides standard names, units and coordinate conventions for your variables: https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.11/cf-conventions.html

For your metadata records, as opposed to the data itself, the profile names **RO-Crate**, which uses schema.org terms in JSON-LD.

COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NetCDF CF-1.11
